supraorbital_contour.structural_silhouette: strongly M-shaped with a distinct central depression
supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Extension visible beyond the lateral margins of the orbital sockets

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast; muzzle and chin exhibit significantly higher pixel intensity (lighter) than the periocular and malar regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Minimal vertical thickness with no observable structural droop

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single light-colored depigmented spot or lesion centrally located on the supraorbital ridge
other_distinctive_markers: Extraneous linear occlusion (vegetation) crossing the mid-face from lower-left to mid-right
